10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:eadede04-f83b-4c.description: Updated: 07 July 2026 Freelance | 8–20 hrs/week | Remote (EU/UK) Are you an experienced intellectual property professional or analyst who can identify nuanced issues and understands the complexities of IP rights in practical business settings? Do you have 8 to 20 hours per week available alongside your main role or consulting projects? Join us in shaping how AI understands and applies intellectual property concepts at scale. About the Role 10x.team connects expert freelancers with leading AI labs building next-generation models. We’re seeking experienced IP analysts and professionals based in the EU or UK to improve the accuracy, depth, and real-world relevance of AI-powered systems in the field of intellectual property. What You Will Do - Review and refine AI-generated outputs on topics such as patent protection, trademark disputes, copyright, infringement assessments, and IP strategy - Evaluate AI responses for practical accuracy, logical structure, and applicability to real business cases - Draft realistic IP scenarios and case studies based on your direct experience - Create variations of scenarios from diverse perspectives (e.g. in-house counsel, IP analyst, rights holder, regulator) - Spot gaps, legal oversights, or flawed reasoning in AI-generated IP content In simple terms: You’ll assess and improve AI-generated intellectual property content, ensuring it reflects authentic reasoning, solid logic, and current best practices. Instead of providing traditional IP advisory or prosecution services, you’ll use your expertise to help AI systems genuinely understand and reason about intellectual property rights at scale. Who You Are - A senior-level IP analyst, consultant, or in-house professional - Based in and eligible to work in the EU or UK - Multiple years of hands-on experience in IP matters (e.g. patents, trademarks, copyright, trade secrets) - Strong ability to assess IP reasoning and distinguish between theoretical concepts and pragmatic, actionable solutions - Comfortable working independently and providing detailed, critical feedback - Available for 8–20 hours per week, with immediate or short-term availability Why Join? - Flexible, fully remote work that fits alongside your current professional commitments - Apply your IP expertise in a rapidly evolving, high-impact AI field - Directly influence the next generation of AI-powered legal and business systems - Free access to our in-house AI Academy to further build your AI knowledge - Structured onboarding, clear briefs, and opportunity for repeat project work How to apply To complete your application, you’ll receive an email right after applying with a link to: - A short written evaluation - A brief AI-powered interview Important: Your application is only complete once you finish all steps via the email link. These are ongoing freelance opportunities and project assignments are matched based on expertise, availability, and AI Lab needs. Please note: these AI Lab missions are not traditional job openings with fixed start dates. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. Join us to help shape the intellectual property expertise of the world’s most advanced AI models! ----------------------------------------- NOTE At 10x, there are two types of opportunities: 1. Traditional freelance missions These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on. 2. AI Lab roles For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities. The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. AI Lab work is often highly confidential as this exposes information of what an AI Lab is working on, and project requests are unpredictable. bumbleinc-bumbleinc:lever:19b3cf8d-8676-.title: Senior Pricing Manager
bumbleinc-bumbleinc:lever:19b3cf8d-8676-.description: At Bumble Inc., our mission is to create a world where all relationships are healthy and equitable — through kindness, accountability, and authentic connection. Pricing plays a meaningful role in that mission by helping us deliver experiences that feel valuable, transparent, and accessible to our global community across Bumble and Badoo. As a Pricing Manager, you will help shape how millions of customers experience value throughout their lifecycle, partnering across Product, Analytics, Marketing, Finance, Payments & Billing, Legal, and Engineering to evolve our pricing and promotion strategies. This role sits at the intersection of customer behavior, experimentation, commercial strategy, and data-driven decision making. You will combine analytical thinking with curiosity and creativity to unlock sustainable payer growth while championing experiences that put our members first. We’re looking for someone who thrives in collaborative environments, takes ownership from insight to impact, and demonstrates Bumble values like Curiosity, Excellence, and Courage in their approach to problem-solving and innovation. You’ll also embrace AI-enabled ways of working to improve efficiency, deepen customer understanding, and support smarter commercial decision-making across the pricing function.
responsibilities: Define and evolve pricing and promotional strategies across Bumble and Badoo to support payer acquisition, conversion, retention, and long-term customer value

Partner closely with the Director of Pricing & Monetization, as well as cross-functional stakeholders, to shape pricing strategy across the full customer lifecycle, balancing customer experience with commercial outcomes
Lead pricing experimentation initiatives, including A/B test design, setup, monitoring, analysis, and recommendation development to optimize monetization performance
Analyze customer behavior, purchasing patterns, elasticity, and promotional effectiveness to generate actionable commercial insights and pricing recommendations
Collaborate with Analytics and Data Science teams to develop deeper customer segmentation, behavioral modeling, and value-based pricing approaches
Work cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Payments & Billing, Legal, Engineering, and Finance teams to ensure pricing changes are operationally scalable, compliant, and customer-centric
Support pricing governance, forecasting, and risk assessment activities to help drive sustainable revenue growth and informed decision-making

Use AI tools and data-driven workflows to improve analysis efficiency, identify emerging trends, enhance experimentation practices, and support faster insight generation while applying thoughtful human judgment.

Ensure billing configuration changes are accurately input, validated, and quality-checked with a high level of attention to detail to minimize risk, and ensure configurations are implemented correctly and efficiently.
Champion an agile mindset by adapting quickly to new insights, testing opportunities, and evolving customer needs while maintaining a high standard of execution
Build strong collaborative relationships across global teams, communicating complex pricing concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
qualifications: Typically requires 6+ years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.
Experience in pricing, monetization, revenue optimization, growth strategy, commercial analytics, or a related function within a digital consumer business
Strong understanding of pricing strategy, promotional mechanics, subscription and consumable product models, and customer lifecycle monetization
Experience designing, executing, and interpreting A/B tests and experimentation frameworks to inform commercial decisions
Ability to translate complex quantitative analysis and customer research into clear recommendations and measurable business impact
Comfortable partnering cross-functionally with Product, Data Science, Marketing, Engineering, Legal, Finance, and operational stakeholders to drive alignment and execution
Experience working with behavioral science principles, value-based pricing strategies, customer segmentation, or pricing optimization models is highly valued
Familiarity with statistical modeling, forecasting methodologies, SQL, experimentation tooling, or pricing algorithms preferred
Demonstrated ability to take ownership of initiatives, prioritize effectively, and deliver results in a fast-paced and evolving environment
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence through collaboration, clarity, and evidence-based recommendations
Experience using AI-enabled tools to improve workflows, uncover insights, support analysis, and enhance decision-making while applying responsible and inclusive judgment
Demonstrates Bumble values through curiosity, respect for diverse perspectives, and a commitment to delivering thoughtful, customer-focused outcomes
Gaming, subscription, social platform, or dating industry experience is helpful but not required

collective-collective:ashbyhq:f8059d32-9.title: Fullstack Software Engineer
collective-collective:ashbyhq:f8059d32-9.description: About Collective: Collective is on a mission to redefine the way businesses-of-one work. Our technology and team of trusted advisors help members achieve financial independence by taking care of everything from business incorporation to accounting, bookkeeping, tax services, and access to a thriving community, all in one integrated platform. We believe in empowering self-employed people to enjoy the same tax savings that big companies get, so they can focus on their passion, not paperwork. Featured in Forbes, Business Insider, Yahoo, Bloomberg, Financial Times, TechCrunch, and more. We are backed by General Catalyst, Sound Ventures (Ashton Kutcher and Guy Oseary), QED Investors, Google’s Gradient Ventures, Expa, and other investors who have financed iconic companies like YouTube, Substack, Twitch, Box, Hims, Instacart, and Lyft. About the role: We're hiring a Software Engineer to help build and scale the systems that power Collective's accounting product, the connection between our members' bank activity, bookkeeping, and tax outcomes. You'll work across the stack on the platform that automates reconciliation, ingests transaction data from our banking and accounting partners, and turns raw financial activity into clean, member-ready books. This is a product engineering role with real ownership, working closely with Product, Design, Operations, and our in-house accounting team to ship fast and iterate based on member and operator feedback. You'll be expected to use modern AI tools and agent-based workflows to accelerate development, improve code quality, and unlock new product capabilities. This role is ideal for engineers who are hungry to grow into broader ownership, think in terms of outcomes, and see AI as a core part of how software gets built today. What you'll do: - Build and ship features across the accounting product - from member-facing reconciliation and bookkeeping experiences to internal tooling that powers our accounting and bookkeeping operators - Work on the integration layer between Collective and our partners that includes extending APIs, handling edge cases, and improving data reliability - Improve the transaction pipeline that flows from bank feeds through our accounting platform into our data layer, including reliability, observability, and drift detection between source and destination - Own well-scoped features end-to-end with support from senior engineers to define the approach, build, deploy, instrument, and iterate - Partner with Product, Design, and Operations to translate accounting workflows into clean software, and surface engineering tradeoffs early - Use AI-powered development tools (copilots, code agents, agent workflows) day-to-day to move faster and cut manual overhead - Clear communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical partners - Demonstrated ability to integrate AI agents and automation into development workflows and product features What you'll bring: - 3–4 years of experience building and shipping production software in a product-focused environment - Solid fullstack engineering skills (e.g., Python, Django, React, or similar modern frameworks) - Experience integrating with third-party APIs and working with messy, real-world data - Hands-on use of AI developer tools (copilots, code agents) in your day-to-day workflow — not just experiments - Ability to take a well-scoped problem and drive it to a shipped, instrumented solution with light guidance - Good product and UX instincts to make sensible scope tradeoffs and ask the right clarifying questions before building - Clear written and verbal communication, especially when explaining tradeoffs to non-engineering partners - Familiarity with SQL and working with data warehouses (BigQuery a plus) - Interest in the accounting / fintech / payroll domain, or a track record of getting up to speed quickly in a new domain What we offer: - Hybrid Work Model: Based in San Francisco with a balance of in-office and remote fl

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:38f.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Chef Instructor, Pastry at Sur La Table, you are the in-store expert and advocate for all things baking and pastry arts. You deliver #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, by sharing specialized knowledge in pastry techniques, baking fundamentals, and personalized instruction that supports all company initiatives. The Chef Instructor, Pastry plays a key role in inspiring a love for baking while driving sales of bakeware, mixers, and decorating tools through hands-on pastry classes and engaging culinary instruction. Key Responsibilities Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Deliver an exceptional in-store culinary experience focused on pastry and baking classes that reflects Sur La Table’s passion for food, teaching, and high standards, while following the provided recipes and game plans to ensure consistency and quality. · Communicate technical concepts and advanced pastry skills in a clear, encouraging, and approachable manner. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as second-class sign-ups, retail culinary product sales, and guest feedback through Google reviews. Team Engagement & Store Support · Assist in setting up and breakdown of classes including organizing mise en place, prepping ingredients, and cleaning workstations. · Clean and sanitize dishes and equipment promptly to ensure smooth kitchen operations. · Assist with restocking, organizing, and maintaining kitchen supplies and tools to support overall store readiness. Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Model and ensure consistent adherence to all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Physical Requirements · Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers. · Ability to remain standing for up to 4 hours at a time. · Ability to move about the store directing class participants while selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. · The capability to accurately perceive and differentiate variations in intensity or quality of flavors or odors, or to identify specific tastes or scents using the tongue or n

Across our family of brands, we support nonprofits, trade associations, and mission-driven organizations with innovative software, impactful marketing strategies, and tools that empower positive change. Here’s why you’ll love working with us: - Stability & Growth: We’re 100% self-funded, with no outside investors or debt, meaning long-term stability and thoughtful growth. - People-First Culture: Our 95%+ employee retention rate reflects our commitment to competitive pay, respect, and career development. - Global Collaboration: Work with talented team members in the US and the Philippines who share your drive for excellence and impact. - Mission-Focused Work: Every role here supports organizations making the world a better place. If you’re ready to grow your career while making a difference, we’d love to hear from you! Watch Our "Meet the Team" Video https://vimeo.com/1059846216/d84c59a1e7?share=copy ROLE We are seeking a highly analytical, strategic, and design-capable Product Designer to drive product development and lead app design projects for Double the Donation’s core application. This role sits at the critical intersection of product strategy and user experience, owning the lifecycle of new features from user research and wireframing to high-fidelity Figma prototyping and engineering handoff. This individual will be responsible for translating complex customer needs and business goals into intuitive, scalable product workflows. We are consistently making changes, improvements, and additions to our nonprofit software. As our web applications grow, you will ensure our product vision is aligned with our developer operations, reducing friction in the user journey and enabling our engineering team to build with clarity and speed. getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:0a26c09c-eeb.title: Digital & Field Events Marketer
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:0a26c09c-eeb.description: Wing is seeking elite talent to join M32 AI (backed by top-tier Silicon Valley VCs), dedicated to building agentic AI for traditional service businesses. Think of it like a startup within a corporate: fast moving and agile, with the stability of a corporate, and zero bureaucracy. If you’re driven by challenge and eager to make a significant impact in a high-caliber role, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. We're hiring a Field & Events Marketer to own our presence at industry events, tradeshows, and conferences across North America. You'll source the right shows, run them end to end, and be the person on the ground making sure every event drives real pipeline. This is a hands-on role for someone 1-4 years into their career who loves logistics, thrives in fast-paced environments, and gets a kick out of pulling off a great event. You'll partner closely with sales, marketing, and product to turn booth space and badge scans into meetings, opportunities, and closed revenue. Why This Role You'll own a high-visibility function from day one. Every event is a chance to shape how customers, prospects, and the industry see us. If you want to grow fast, take real ownership, and build a portfolio of events you're genuinely proud of, this is the seat for you.
responsibilities: Source and prioritize events. Research, evaluate, and recommend tradeshows, conferences, and industry events that align with our ICP and revenue goals. Own a rolling 12-month event calendar.
Negotiate and contract. Manage relationships with event organizers, vendors, and venues. Negotiate sponsorships, booth space, speaking slots, and add-ons to stretch every dollar.
Plan and execute end to end. Own every detail, including booth design and shipping, swag, collateral, lead capture, badge scanners, AV, catering, hotel blocks, and travel logistics for the team.
Be the on-site point of contact. Attend every event in person. Set up and tear down booths, troubleshoot in real time, and make sure our presence looks sharp from start to finish.
Prep the team. Brief attending team members on objectives, talking points, target accounts, and logistics. Make sure everyone knows where to be, when, and what to do.
Drive pipeline with sales. Partner with sales to book pre-show meetings, run dinners and customer events on-site, and ensure every lead is captured, qualified, and followed up on quickly.
Run pre- and post-event campaigns. Work with marketing on email outreach, landing pages, paid promotion, and social to drive booth traffic and meeting bookings before the show.
Own the budget. Manage event spend across the full calendar. Track costs, forecast accurately, flag risks early, and make smart trade-off decisions when priorities shift.
Define KPIs and report on results. Set clear KPIs for each event (leads, meetings, pipeline, ROI) and build clean post-event reports that show what worked, what didn't, and how to improve next time.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:df8f0b1d-0df7-.title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
jobgether-jobgether:lever:df8f0b1d-0df7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst based in South Africa. This remote opportunity is designed for professionals and aspiring analysts looking to build practical experience in cyber threat intelligence through realistic, simulation-based environments. You will work with incomplete threat information, indicators, contextual data, and organizational requirements to determine what matters and why. The role emphasizes analytical judgment, source evaluation, threat prioritization, and decision-focused intelligence. You will translate technical findings into clear assessments and recommendations for different stakeholders. The work spans threat actors, TTPs, indicators, intelligence gaps, and evolving assessments.
